_comment: Maps gateway failure codes and common raw decline strings to classification buckets. Keys are lowercased before lookup.

codes: not enough balance to complete this transaction
insufficient_funds.description: Customer doesn't have enough money in the account.

card_expired.description: Card has passed its expiry date.

codes: bank server did not respond in time
transaction timed out - please try again
bank_timeout.description: Bank didn't respond in time / was unavailable.

3ds_failed.description: 3D Secure authentication failed or was rejected.

codes: transaction declined by bank without reason
generic_decline.description: Card was declined for a generic or unspecified reason.
